storyPoints.title: Dodavatel notebooků začíná zpožďovat dodávky
storyPoints.description: Od března se výrazně zvyšuje pravděpodobnost, že dodávka notebooků od dodavatele SUP-002 dorazí se zpožděním 7–25 dnů. Ostatní dodavatelé a ostatní parametry procesu zůstávají beze změny.

storyPoints.title: Prodejnám dochází notebooky
storyPoints.description: Pozdní dodávky nedoplňují zásoby, notebooky tohoto dodavatele se na prodejnách vyprodají a zákazníci odcházejí bez nákupu.

storyPoints.title: Přibývá stížností na nedostupnost
storyPoints.description: Při stejné pravděpodobnosti stížnosti vzniká víc stížností, protože přibývá ztracených prodejů notebooků tohoto dodavatele.

expectations.description: Počet ztracených prodejů notebooků dodavatele SUP-002 za den vzroste po začátku zpoždění dodávek.
expectations.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date AS DATE) AS d FROM main.sale WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2024-03-01' OR CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2024-03-15'), c AS (SELECT CAST(l.date AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM main.lost_sale l JOIN main.product p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE p.category = 'notebook' AND p.supplier_id = 'SUP-002' GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN days.d < DATE '2024-03-01' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, CAST(AVG(COALESCE(c.n, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM days LEFT JOIN c ON c.d = days.d GROUP BY 1

expectations.description: Počet stížností na nedostupnost notebooků dodavatele SUP-002 za den vzroste.
expectations.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date AS DATE) AS d FROM main.sale WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2024-03-01' OR CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2024-03-20'), c AS (SELECT CAST(k.date AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM main.complaint k JOIN main.product p ON p.id = k.product_id WHERE p.category = 'notebook' AND p.supplier_id = 'SUP-002' GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN days.d < DATE '2024-03-01' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, CAST(AVG(COALESCE(c.n, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM days LEFT JOIN c ON c.d = days.d GROUP BY 1

expectations.description: Počet prodaných notebooků dodavatele SUP-002 za den klesne, protože není zboží na skladě.
expectations.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date AS DATE) AS d FROM main.sale WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2024-03-01' OR CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2024-03-15'), c AS (SELECT CAST(s.date AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM main.sale s JOIN main.product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.category = 'notebook' AND p.supplier_id = 'SUP-002' GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN days.d < DATE '2024-03-01' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, CAST(AVG(COALESCE(c.n, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM days LEFT JOIN c ON c.d = days.d GROUP BY 1

expectations.description: Kontrola: prodeje produktů ostatních dodavatelů než SUP-002 za den zůstávají stabilní.
expectations.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date AS DATE) AS d FROM main.sale WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2024-03-01' OR CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2024-03-15'), c AS (SELECT CAST(s.date AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM main.sale s JOIN main.product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id <> 'SUP-002' GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN days.d < DATE '2024-03-01' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, CAST(AVG(COALESCE(c.n, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM days LEFT JOIN c ON c.d = days.d GROUP BY 1

expectations.description: Kontrola: celková poptávka (prodeje plus ztracené prodeje) po produktech ostatních dodavatelů než SUP-002 za den zůstává stabilní.
expectations.sql: WITH allrows AS (SELECT CAST(s.date AS DATE) AS d FROM main.sale s JOIN main.product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id <> 'SUP-002' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(l.date AS DATE) AS d FROM main.lost_sale l JOIN main.product p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id <> 'SUP-002'), per_day AS (SELECT d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM allrows WHERE d < DATE '2024-03-01' OR d >= DATE '2024-03-15' GROUP BY d) SELECT CASE WHEN d < DATE '2024-03-01' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, CAST(AVG(n) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM per_day GROUP BY 1
